definition: Retinitis pigmentosa 101 (RP101; OMIM #621548) is an autosomal recessive retinal disorder associated with pathogenic variants in the CLN3 gene, characterized by progressive rod-cone dystrophy with retinal atrophy.

source.title: CLN3 Gene
